subject: SIG follow-up: incident notification windows & POC details
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acmepayments.com>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acmepayments.com
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 13:45:00 -0800
Subject: SIG follow-up: incident notification windows & POC questions

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for sending the initial SIG responses. A couple of follow-ups from our security team as we work through our vendor review:

- Can you confirm Redwood's typical breach notification windows (for example, do you have a 72-hour maximum for confirmed incidents, and do you provide a 24-48h acknowledgement for suspected incidents?)
- Who are the escalation points of contact (phone + email) for both business hours and 24x7 emergency escalation?
- For the SIG evidence, which artifacts will you provide: audit logs, timeline exports, incident playbook excerpts, SOC 2 test evidence?
- For customers in the EU, do you handle notifications differently or provide a separate timeline commitment?

We may also need a redacted excerpt of your IR playbook for our internal approvers. Can you share a short snippet or point us to the relevant document?

Would appreciate concise answers so we can close this section of the SIG. If it's easier, we're open to a 20-minute sync next week.

Best,
Alex Chen
Security Lead — Acme Payments
alex.chen@acmepayments.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

[Attachment: acme_sig_questions.xlsx]

From: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>

Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: incident notification windows & POC questions

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers below, and I attached a compact SIG responses PDF plus a short playbook excerpt for your reviewers.

- Notification cadence: We operate to a 72-hour maximum window for confirmed data-security incidents (time-to-notify external customers / regulators where applicable). For suspected incidents we provide a preliminary acknowledgement within 24 hours and an initial summary within 48 hours where possible; final timelines depend on scope and legal review.

- Escalation POCs:
  - Primary: Security operations (24x7) — security@redwood.com (monitored)
  - On-call Phone (emergencies): +1 (888) 777-9001 (pager -> SRE on-call)
  - Incident Manager (business hours): Rishi Malhotra — rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
  - Head of Security (escalation): Laura Bennett — laura.bennett@redwood.com

- Evidence we can supply (SIG-friendly artifacts): audit/log extracts (SCIM/login/vault access), redacted timeline exports, incident playbook excerpt, and SOC 2 attestation references. We provide artifacts as redacted PDFs or text extracts; raw logs require a data request with an NDA/secure transfer if needed.

- EU customers: Our commitment is aligned with local regulator expectations (GDPR 72-hour supervisory notification where applicable). We do not shorten the external notification window below 72 hours; local legal counsel may adjust cadence for regulator filings, and we will coordinate with the customer’s legal team.

I attached: redwood_sig_RESPONSES_v1.pdf (SIG answers) and incident_playbook_excerpt.txt (redacted excerpt).

If useful, we can do a 20-minute call Friday to walk through the artifacts. Proposed times: Fri 02/26 09:30am PT or 12:30pm PT.

Thanks — Jasmine Liu
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

[Attachment: redwood_sig_RESPONSES_v1.pdf]
[Attachment: incident_playbook_excerpt.txt]

Date: Fri, 26 Feb 2027 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: incident notification windows & POC questions

Thanks, Jasmine — that helps a lot and we received the two attachments. A couple quick clarifications after our security working group reviewed them:

- The SOC 2 attestation reference in the PDF looks like a summary. Can you confirm whether we can get the actual SOC 2 report under NDA (or a bridge letter) for the last 12 months?
- For EU customers: when you say "coordinate with the customer’s legal team", does Redwood have an internal GDPR response lead who can take a direct point-of-contact for regulator coordination? If so, can we have their name/email?

We also want to confirm: if there's a potential compromise of customer-derived embeddings or stored vectors, would Redwood treat that as a data-security incident subject to the same 72-hour window (i.e., included in your incident classification)?

If the SOC 2 report requires NDA, please send the instructions and a contact for legal. Otherwise, happy to take the proposed 09:30 PT call if Rishi or Laura can join.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Alex

Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: incident notification windows & POC questions — confirmation and next steps

Hi Alex — looping in a couple more details from a security ops / legal coordination perspective so you have a single reference: 

1) SOC 2 report: We can provide the full SOC 2 Type II report under NDA. Please have your legal team send an NDA to legal@redwood.com and we will route the report via a secure transfer (we typically use a time-limited secure link). If you need a bridge letter instead, state that in the NDA email and we will coordinate.

2) EU/regulator coordination: Our GDPR/regulatory contact is Vivek Kulkarni (cc'd). Vivek will act as the Redwood lead for regulator handoffs and will coordinate filings with the customer legal team and our external counsel where required.

3) Vector/embedding compromise: Yes — any confirmed compromise of customer data (including persisted embeddings or vector databases that are customer-owned or tenant-separated) is treated as a data-security incident and falls under the notification cadence above. We will include affected artifact types in the initial summary and provide redacted evidence exports per the requested scope.

4) Phone escalation: the emergency pager number Jasmine listed (+1 (888) 777-9001) routes to on-call SRE; for direct legal/escalation handoff during an incident you can reach Incident Manager Rishi at +1 (650) 555-1044 (business hours) or email security@redwood.com for 24x7 triage.

Next steps: If you confirm an NDA is acceptable, please copy legal@redwood.com and we will send the secure SOC 2 transfer instructions. Otherwise, we can run the 20-minute sync tomorrow at 09:30 PT; I'll join with Laura to review artifacts and answer any classification questions.

Thanks — Rishi Malhotra
Incident Manager, Redwood Inference
